All eleven research documents validated across 5b9b15a and 1aaa4ba. Every checkable claim re-derived from source rather than re-read. Substantive findings held; the defects were metadata — version stamps from the default toolchain rather than the pinned one, quotes attributed to the wrong artifact, claims broader than their evidence, code quotes that would not compile, and counts produced by eye. Two spin-off issues remain open: okm-3a3 (agent instruction files in .changeset/) and okm-gcq (the survey-table rows still unverified, which the docs now name rather than imply coverage of).

All three specs validated. bump-files.md gained the add interface its own open question had said to write since 2026-08-18 — the omission that let the add verb go missing from ADR-0023. init.md and migrate.md declared four ADRs they had relied on silently, and migrate.md's first correction cited ADR-0020, which settles that check and release share one precondition implementation that migrate never enters; ADR-0011's never-roll-back preflight is the real driver. Two review iterations caught three over-corrections of mine, including an edge case that would have broken init's own idempotency by blocking on the README it writes. The skip-list contract is now settled asymmetrically on purpose: migrate warns on all four and blocks on none, init reports three and continues. Downstream artifacts — the guide and the shipped template — were aligned after a review caught that the contract had changed and the thing that ships it had not.

All eight ideas reviewed. Promotion fields and the docs/README.md index agree; a reviewer checked all eight against the 23 ADRs and found no contradictions. Four changed.

0006's open question — were the three bumpy patches upstreamed — is answered: they were not, and across all 150 pull requests in any state no outside human has ever opened one (theoephraim 107, bumpy-bot 39, github-actions 4). But the issue tracker inverts the framing: 8 of 9 issues are outside-authored and 6 are closed, several within hours, so the maintainer does engage with strangers and only merge behavior is untested. The plugin-system item is now an open PR (#153, since 2026-07-31) rather than a roadmap line, which sharpens the ADR-0013 divergence.

0003 was NOT promoted despite a research document saying its questions were answered. Only an adjacent one is: the research settles pre-commit versus pre-push, never either versus plain check. The research doc was corrected at its source. Its second question is blocked on the same marker as add --empty; the third gained a real lead — git's pre-push hook supplies the destination, so it is not blocked, just unwritten.

0001 cited no ADR for the command hook it proposes replacing; ADR-0013 now declared. 0007 gained the tag-format interaction from okm-141.

clippy.toml denylist (59 paths, all verified to resolve) plus the lint level in Cargo.toml's [workspace.lints.clippy]; tests/io_boundary.rs proves the denylist is loaded, that every path resolves, and that the expect marker suppresses and a stale one fails. Types landed in src/plan/workspace.rs: PackageId (ecosystem-qualified), Package with current version and ResolvesDependenciesAt, DependencyKind retained per manifest section, DeclaredRange preserving protocol prefixes, and a validating Workspace::new. 7 unit tests; mise check and the full test suite pass.
